title.narrative: Capacity Building of Women on Community-Based Inventorying of Female Traditional Dances of the Northern Region of Malawi

description.narrative: The project is aimed at safeguarding female traditional dances in five (5) districts of the northern region namely: Chitipa, Karonga, Rumphi, Mzimba and Nkhatabay districts through inventorying. First 30 female teachers and community-based female youth, six from each district, will be trained on community-based inventorying of ICH, followed by the actual Community-based inventorying of the traditional dances both of which will be recorded on audiovisual media. Each trained team of six will conduct community-based inventorying of dances in their respective district. Project outputs will consist of the 30 trained women, an inventory of the traditional dances and audiovisual recordings.
